name: Search for the Standard Model Higgs Boson at LEP

summary.plain: The four LEP experiments combined their searches for the Standard Model Higgs boson in 2461 inverse picobarns of electron-positron collisions at 189 to 209 GeV. The combination establishes a lower bound of 114.4 GeV/c² on the Higgs boson mass at the 95% confidence level.
summary.technical: ALEPH, DELPHI, L3 and OPAL (the LEP Working Group for Higgs Boson Searches) combined 2461 pb^-1 of e+e- data at centre-of-mass energies between 189 and 209 GeV in a likelihood test of the background and signal-plus-background hypotheses (Phys. Lett. B 565, 2003, 61-75; arXiv:hep-ex/0306033): a lower bound of 114.4 GeV/c^2 is established at the 95% confidence level on the mass of the Standard Model Higgs boson, and upper bounds are set on the HZZ coupling for various assumptions concerning the decay of the Higgs boson.

title: Search for the Standard Model Higgs Boson at LEP
